title: Ten Cats, Ten Nuts
lines: Meg got ten nuts in a pot.
Meg set the pot on a cot.
The cats did tip the pot.
Nuts on the mat! Nuts in the cup!
The cats bat the nuts. Meg is mad.
Meg sat on the mat. Meg can bat nuts.
Ten cats. Ten nuts. It is fun.

questions.ask: Where did Meg put the pot of nuts?
questions.listenFor: On a cot. The story says it. If your child guesses, have them find the word cot and read that line again.

questions.ask: What did the cats do with the nuts?
questions.listenFor: They tipped the pot over and batted the nuts around. Listen for the batting - that is what turns the mess into a game.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg is still mad at the end? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason from the story, like she sat down and joined in, or she said it was fun.
